signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with the owner account to manage this payment guard.

setup.title: Create the owner account
setup.intro: This installation has no owner yet. The account you create now is the only one that can sign in; after that, sign-up closes.
setup.rule: At least 12 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit.

errors.invalid: That email and password don't match the owner account.
errors.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.notOwner: That account is not this installation's owner.
errors.ownerExists: The owner account already exists. Sign in with it.
errors.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.weak: The password is too weak: use at least 12 characters, with a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit.
errors.signUpFailed: The account could not be created. Check the email and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
